hazards.message: Content is rendered without sanitising, so never pass caller-supplied or database HTML through it. Use Html for anything a user could have written.
DOMPurifyOptions is read once when the block mounts, so a value that changes after the first render has no effect. Set it statically or remount the block.

Html is deprecated. Use the Template block: it escapes every value by default (Html renders a string that is only sanitised afterwards), it takes a context of values instead of one concatenated string, and {% slot "name" %} places real Lowdefy blocks inside the markup.

Content is sanitised with DOMPurify, so <style>, <script> and inline event handlers are removed before render. Use DangerousHtml for a trusted <style> block, or style the block through its style and class properties.
Every {{ value }} is HTML-escaped. The "| safe" filter turns escaping off for that value, so never apply it to caller-supplied or database strings - only to markup the app itself produced.

properties.css is CSS text scoped to this block (nested under [id="bl-<blockId>"]). Braces must balance - a stray "}" would escape the scope and is rejected. The style key stays an object of CSS properties per cssKey; a <style> tag inside the template is stripped.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when icon is clicked.

alt.description: Alternative text description of the image.

crossOrigin.description: Indicates if the fetching of the image must be done using a CORS request.

decoding.description: An image decoding hint to the browser. Sync for atomic presentation with other content, async,  to reduce delay in presenting other content and auto leave to browser to decide.

loading.description: How the browser should load the image. Eager loads the image immediately, lazy, defers loading until the image it reaches a calculated distance from the viewport, as defined by the browser.

sizes.description: Indicating a set of source sizes of strings separated by commas.

srcSet.description: Possible image sources for the user agent to use, strings separated by commas.

direction.description: List content along a 'row' or down a 'column'. Applies the 'flex-direction' css property to the List block.

wrap.description: Specifies wrapping style to be applied to List block as 'wrap', 'nowrap' or 'wrap-reverse'. Applies the 'flex-wrap' css property to the List block - defaults to 'wrap', requires List direction to be set.

scroll.description: Specifies whether scrolling should be applied to the List, can be true or false. Applies the 'overflow' css property to the List block - defaults to 'visible', requires List direction to be set.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when the List is clicked.

wrap.description: Whether children that do not fit move to a new line. Use "nowrap" to keep one line and let the children shrink.

align.description: Alignment of the children on the cross (vertical) axis.

justify.description: Distribution of the children along the main (horizontal) axis.

content.description: Span content string. Overrides the "content" content area.

onClick.description: Trigger actions when the Span is clicked.

align.description: Alignment of the children on the cross (horizontal) axis.

template.description: Nunjucks template source. {{ value }} is escaped, {{ value | safe }} is not, and {% slot "name" %} places the blocks configured under slots.name.

context.description: Values available to the template. Objects are spread into the template scope; a primitive is available as "value".

css.description: CSS text applied to this block only. Rules are nested under the block wrapper selector, so ".row { ... }" styles only .row elements inside this block.

message.default: Intentional error thrown by Throw block

progress.description: Progress percentage to show, from 0 to 100.

shadow.description: Render the glowing shadow at the head of the bar.

shape.description: Shape of the skeleton; round gives fully rounded ends.

label.description: Render the label skeleton. Set to false for an input without a label.

lines.description: Number of paragraph lines of the skeleton.

size.description: Size of the icon spinner: small, medium, large, or a pixel number.

content.description: The content of the message - supports html.

duration.description: Time(seconds) before auto-dismiss, don't dismiss if set to 0.

icon.description: Name of an React-Icon (See all icons) or properties of an Icon block to customize message icon.

onClose.description: Trigger actions when message is closed.

params.description: Value to negate. Any value is negated by its truthiness.

oneOf.description: Type name to test against state value at current location. The "empty" test is true for null, undefined, '' and [], and false for 0, false and {}.

on.description: Value to test the type of.

key.description: State key to test the type of.
